en.headline: Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance returns for three Mid-Autumn nights
en.dek: The national intangible cultural heritage parade runs from 24 to 26 September, with road closures in Tai Hang and a planned stop at Victoria Park on festival night.
body: The Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance will be staged over three nights from 24 to 26 September for the Mid-Autumn Festival, with the Transport Department confirming road closures and diversions in the neighbourhood for the duration of the event.

The dance is organised by the Tai Hang Residents' Welfare Association and has been performed for more than a century. Villagers began the rite in the late nineteenth century after a plague, and the item was inscribed on the national list of intangible cultural heritage in 2011. Performers carry a long dragon studded with incense through the streets of the former Hakka village.

Leisure and Cultural Services Department festival programmes list a Tai Hang fire dragon segment at the Victoria Park lantern carnival on 25 September, after local street processions on the first two evenings. Lighting at the park carnival runs from 6.30pm to 11pm daily until 27 September, and until midnight on Mid-Autumn night.

The department and police will manage crowds and traffic in Causeway Bay. People heading to Tai Hang or Victoria Park were advised to use public transport, follow stewarding on the night, and avoid burning wax or flying sky lanterns at leisure venues.

zh.headline: 大坑舞火龍中秋一連三晚上演 區內實施封路
zh.dek: 這項國家非遺將於9月24至26日舉行，大坑會封路改道，中秋正日火龍亦會前往維園綵燈會。
body: 大坑舞火龍將於9月24至26日一連三晚上演，慶祝中秋。運輸署已公布期間大坑一帶會封路及改道，方便活動進行。
活動由大坑坊眾福利會舉辦，已有逾百年歷史。相傳十九世紀末大坑村發生疫疫後，村民以舞火龍祈福，項目於2011年列入國家非物質文化遺產名錄。表演者會抬着插滿香枝的長龍，巡遊昔日客家村落的街道。
康樂及文化事務署的中秋節目列出，火龍在頭兩晚於大坑巡遊後，9月25日中秋正日會前往維多利亞公園綵燈會。維園綵燈會亮燈時間為每日下午6時半至11時，舉行至9月27日，中秋正日延長至午夜。
康文署及警方會在銅鑼灣一帶管理人流及交通。前往大坑或維園的市民宜乘搭公共交通，聽從現場指示，亦不要在康文場地燒蜡或放天燈。
